untrustedWorkspaces.description: Build reports read local project source files to verify error locations.

latexExact.reportPaths.description: Build report paths, absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

latexExact.background.description: Optionally add a background behind compiler-confirmed errors. Live findings have a separate configurable background color.

latexExact.nodePath.description: Node.js executable used for the build wrapper. Common macOS locations are detected automatically.

latexExact.liveStructure.description: Show live structural warnings while typing, before a compiler build.

latexExact.lintDelay.description: Milliseconds after the last edit before analyzing the current unsaved LaTeX buffers.

latexExact.liveHighlightColor.description: Live highlight background as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (the last two digits control opacity). Yellow: #ffd54f55. Red: #ff555555. Changes apply immediately.

latexExact.keepLiveHighlightsWhileTyping.description: Keep live highlights on untouched tokens while typing. Editing a highlighted token clears it immediately; all findings refresh after the typing pause. Disable to clear all live highlights on each edit.

latexExact.liveCheck.description: Enable macro-aware live diagnostics without saving or compiling.

latexExact.liveCommands.description: Check unrecognized commands against project definitions and loaded package metadata.

latexExact.additionalCommands.description: Additional valid command names for generated macros or unsupported definition mechanisms (with or without a leading backslash).

latexExact.ordinaryParentheses.description: Optional informational hints for ordinary parentheses. Mixed square/round intervals and sized delimiters are excluded.
